source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Directly stimulating muscle contraction, an effect essentially opposite to what this medication is actually intended to produce","B":"Carrying fairly little established role in managing spasticity despite being commonly prescribed for this purpose","C":"Curing the client's underlying spinal cord injury itself, rather than managing one of its associated symptoms","D":"Acting on the central nervous system to reduce muscle spasticity, likely through effects on spinal cord reflex activity"}}
source_row.rationale: Baclofen acts on the central nervous system to reduce muscle spasticity, likely through effects on spinal cord reflex activity, commonly used to help manage spasticity related to spinal cord injury or other neurological conditions, though it does not address the underlying injury itself.
